method: Amortized factorized Bernoulli support with input-dependent point nonnegative amplitude and a learned linear dictionary; exact expected quadratic loss plus normalized support prior and entropy, conditional on amplitude; fixed-gamma base.
not_claimed: automatic true L0 from a learned Bernoulli prior
specific_caution: The current algebraic delta is a narrow adaptation of known VG to amortized learned-dictionary inference with a point amplitude, beside S3C/VSC. A demonstrable feature-identity/unknown-sparsity effect or compelling compute-accuracy result must carry the contribution.
defensible_delta: Conditional support-only amortized VG risk for learned SAE dictionaries, tested as a mechanism for reducing signed feature mixing under misspecified sparsity.
